h1: Private Jet to Spain from Mexico City
hero_sub: Tapas past midnight in Madrid, Gaudí's spires against a blue Barcelona sky, summer coves in Ibiza, one overnight flight from Toluca.
answer: A private jet to Spain from Mexico City takes about 11 hours nonstop from Toluca (AIT) to Madrid-Barajas (MAD) or Barcelona El Prat (BCN), and long-range charters start at $100,000 USD one way for the whole aircraft. That covers a Gulfstream GV or Global Express for up to 16 passengers, with crew, fuel, catering and permits. Allow 48 to 72 hours for transatlantic overflight permits.
story_title: An overnight crossing to the Old World
story: Spain runs on a different clock. Lunch starts at two, dinner at ten, and in Madrid the terraces of La Latina are still full past midnight. Barcelona pairs Gothic lanes with the Sagrada Família and a city beach a few metro stops away. In the south, Marbella's Golden Mile and the white villages of Andalusia trade city energy for sea light, and from May to October Ibiza fills its coves, beach clubs and farmhouse restaurants with people who planned the trip all year.

Getting there is usually the tiring part. Commercial flights from Mexico City mean fixed departure times, a crowded terminal and a long passport line at Barajas. A private jet to Spain flies nonstop in about 11 hours, so you can leave Toluca after an early dinner, sleep on a fully reclined seat and land in Madrid in the early afternoon. Families keep their own rhythm, and executives arrive rested enough to go straight into a meeting.
why_title: Why charter a private jet to Spain

why.d: The Gulfstream GV and Global Express have the range to fly from Toluca to Madrid or Barcelona in about 11 hours without a fuel stop. You board once in Mexico and step off in Spain, with your luggage in the same hold the whole way.

Long-range cabins carry up to 16 passengers with space to work, dine and sleep. A family heading to a summer villa, or a board traveling to a week of meetings in Madrid, crosses the Atlantic together with every suitcase aboard.

Transatlantic flights need overflight permits across several countries and arrival coordination in Spain. JETCAB arranges them together with handling at your Spanish airport. Allow 48 to 72 hours from confirmation so every clearance is in place before departure.

Long-range charters to Spain start at $100,000 USD one way for the whole aircraft, with crew, fuel, catering and permits included. Other aircraft, return legs and multi-city itineraries are quoted on WhatsApp within 30 minutes of your request.

journey_title: Your overnight flight from Mexico City to Madrid

journey.d: Your driver collects you in the early evening for the 45 to 60 minute drive west to Toluca. With less time to spare, the JETCAB helicopter transfer from Polanco, Lomas, Santa Fe or Reforma takes about 25 minutes.
Car to aircraft steps in under 10 minutes. Mexican exit immigration is handled at the private terminal, your luggage goes into the hold, and the crew settles you into the cabin for the night ahead.

Wheels up. Dinner is served as the jet climbs northeast across the Gulf of Mexico toward the Atlantic. Then the lights go down, the seats recline fully and you sleep through most of the 11-hour crossing.

You land at Madrid-Barajas around 2:00 pm local time in winter; Spain is seven hours ahead of Mexico City in winter and eight in summer. Passport control and customs are handled through the business aviation terminal.

The Salamanca district, Madrid's most elegant shopping neighborhood, is about 20 to 30 minutes away. Check in, walk Calle Serrano and sit down to a late lunch, which is right on schedule in Madrid. Dinner starts around ten.

places_title: What to do in Spain after you land

places.name: Madrid
places.d: Start at the Prado and its rooms of Velázquez and Goya, then cross to Retiro Park for a rowboat on the lake. Evenings belong to tapas in La Latina and dinner in Salamanca. Football fans can tour the rebuilt Santiago Bernabéu, home of Real Madrid, a short ride from the center.

places.name: Barcelona
places.d: Gaudí gave the city its signature skyline, from the Sagrada Família to Park Güell and Casa Batlló on Passeig de Gràcia. Walk the Gothic Quarter in the morning, eat seafood rice at Barceloneta for lunch, and watch the sun set over the port from Montjuïc. JETCAB also flies to Barcelona El Prat.

places.name: Marbella
places.d: On the Costa del Sol, Marbella pairs the whitewashed old town around Plaza de los Naranjos with the beach clubs and yachts of Puerto Banús. The Golden Mile links them with villas and grand hotels. The nearest major airport is Málaga, about 45 minutes away by car.

places.name: Ibiza
places.d: Beyond the famous clubs, the island has quiet coves such as Cala d'Hort facing the rock of Es Vedrà, the walled old town of Dalt Vila, and farmhouse restaurants in the north. The season runs roughly from May to October, and Ibiza has its own international airport.

best_time_title: When to fly a private jet to Spain
best_time: Spring and autumn are ideal for the cities: April to June and September to October bring mild days in Madrid and Barcelona and fewer crowds. Madrid celebrates San Isidro in mid-May, and Seville's April Fair follows a couple of weeks after Easter. July and August are hot inland and peak season on the coast, when Marbella and Ibiza are at their liveliest. Winter is quiet and good for museums and shopping. Transatlantic flights need 48 to 72 hours for overflight permits, and for summer weekends on the islands, reserve your aircraft several weeks ahead.
airport: JETCAB flies to Madrid-Barajas (MAD) and Barcelona El Prat (BCN). Both airports have business aviation terminals where private passengers clear passport control and customs away from the main halls, with the handling arranged by JETCAB before departure. From Barajas, the Salamanca district and central Madrid are about 20 to 30 minutes by car. From El Prat, Passeig de Gràcia is roughly 25 minutes away. For Marbella or Ibiza, ask for a quote to Málaga or Ibiza airport, and your car can be waiting at the terminal door.
docs_title: Documents for flying private to Spain
docs: Mexican and US citizens currently enter Spain without a visa for short stays of up to 90 days in any 180-day period, with a passport valid at least three months beyond the date they leave the Schengen area. The EU's biometric Entry/Exit System now registers non-EU travelers at the border, and the ETIAS travel authorization is due to begin, so check its status before you fly. JETCAB handles overflight and landing permits, which take 48 to 72 hours.

faq.q: How long is a private jet flight from Mexico City to Spain?
faq.a: About 11 hours nonstop from Toluca (AIT) to Madrid (MAD) or Barcelona (BCN), a distance of roughly 9,200 km, on a long-range Gulfstream GV or Global Express. Leaving Toluca at 8:00 pm puts you in Madrid in the early afternoon, local time, after a night's sleep on board.

faq.q: How much does a private jet to Spain cost?
faq.a: A private jet to Spain from Mexico City starts at $100,000 USD one way for the whole aircraft, on a Gulfstream GV or Global Express for up to 16 passengers. Crew, fuel, catering, permits and handling are included. Return legs and other aircraft are quoted within 30 minutes on WhatsApp.

faq.q: Are private jets allowed to fly internationally?
faq.a: Yes. Private jets cross borders every day, provided the operator holds the right authorizations and files the permits each country requires. JETCAB has operated since 1999 under an AFAC operating permit and arranges the overflight and landing clearances for transatlantic flights, which is why Spain needs 48 to 72 hours of lead time.

faq.q: Which aircraft fly nonstop from Mexico to Spain?
faq.a: Long-range jets such as the Gulfstream GV and the Global Express, which can cross the Atlantic from Toluca without a fuel stop. Both carry up to 16 passengers with reclining seats, a galley for proper meals and space to sleep through the night before landing in Madrid or Barcelona.

faq.q: Can I fly private to Ibiza or Marbella from Mexico?
faq.a: Ask for it when you request your quote. Ibiza has its own international airport, and Málaga is the closest major airport to Marbella, about 45 minutes away by car. Flight time, aircraft and price for either route are confirmed on WhatsApp within 30 minutes, permits included.

faq.q: Do you tip a private jet pilot?
faq.a: Tipping is not required, and no gratuity is ever added to a JETCAB quote since the price already covers the crew. On a long overnight crossing, if the crew went out of their way for your family, a tip is a personal gesture left entirely to you.
